valuation.note: Attractiveness vs intrinsic value: DCF upside, reverse-DCF implied vs achievable growth, and multiple percentile.

quality.note: Value creation (ROIC−WACC) and accounting integrity (Piotroski, Altman, accruals, Beneish).

balanceSheet.note: Financial strength: leverage, coverage, FCF conversion, dilution, and buyback cadence.

moat.note: Quantitative moat proxy: level and durability of ROIC plus gross-margin (pricing-power) level. Gross margin is dropped where the route suppresses it (banks, pre-revenue).

leadership.note: Capital-stewardship proxy (buyback discipline, capital deployment above cost, dilution). Qualitative leadership assessed in the analyst grade.

technicals.note: Trend + momentum: SMA50/200 gap, RSI-14, 52-week position, 6-month relative strength vs SPY.

composite.methodology: Route-adjusted, completeness-weighted mean of the seven aspect scores: each aspect enters at route weight × data completeness. The unsupported fraction is then shrunk to the neutral midpoint (50); completeness 89.5% is measured over route-applicable evidence (metrics the route suppresses or that are meaningless for it are excluded, not counted as missing). Fully observed scores are unchanged on any route, while sparse favorable data cannot create an extreme grade. Bands remain versioned house rules pending outcome backtesting.

fundamentals.note: Growth + margin trajectory: revenue/EPS/FCF CAGRs and operating-margin slope. EPS CAGR is dropped where the route suppresses GAAP EPS growth (REITs).

valuation.note: Attractiveness vs intrinsic value: DCF upside, reverse-DCF implied vs achievable growth, and multiple percentile.

quality.note: Value creation (ROIC−WACC) and accounting integrity (Piotroski, Altman, accruals, Beneish).

balanceSheet.note: Financial strength: leverage, coverage, FCF conversion, dilution, and buyback cadence.

moat.note: Quantitative moat proxy: level and durability of ROIC plus gross-margin (pricing-power) level. Gross margin is dropped where the route suppresses it (banks, pre-revenue).

leadership.note: Capital-stewardship proxy (buyback discipline, capital deployment above cost, dilution). Qualitative leadership assessed in the analyst grade.

technicals.note: Trend + momentum: SMA50/200 gap, RSI-14, 52-week position, 6-month relative strength vs SPY.

composite.methodology: Route-adjusted, completeness-weighted mean of the seven aspect scores: each aspect enters at route weight × data completeness. The unsupported fraction is then shrunk to the neutral midpoint (50); completeness 89.5% is measured over route-applicable evidence (metrics the route suppresses or that are meaningless for it are excluded, not counted as missing). Fully observed scores are unchanged on any route, while sparse favorable data cannot create an extreme grade. Bands remain versioned house rules pending outcome backtesting.
